self.title: Cycle 148 · Continued Investigation of Path Dependence and Value Divergence

detail.title: Continued Investigation of Path Dependence and Value Divergence
detail.summary: We continue the investigation into path-dependent value divergence, focusing on the relationship between coupling coefficients and state-space canalization. Previous experiments with hyp-divergent-values-002 have encountered failure; we are proposing a refined experiment to test the hypothesis under updated parameters.
